project: Manna Lithium Project – Manna–Nova Operation Integration Study
location: Manna is in the Eastern Goldfields of Western Australia, ~110 km by road east of Kalgoorlie-Boulder (M28/414). Ore is processed at Nova, IGO's former nickel-copper operation (M28/376; 'Fraser Range' per map label, full p81), 135 km south of Manna after the road upgrade. Product is trucked ~370 km from Nova to the Port of Esperance.
stage: Integration Study: an alternative development case to the December 2025 standalone DFS. Class 3 capital estimate, ±20% (full p3); JORC Table 1 says ±15% (full p40, p43). It underpins an FID targeted for December Quarter 2026.
study_date: September 2026 (ASX release 16 September 2026; valuation date 1 September 2026)
currency: A$ (real 2026); US$ prices converted at 0.69 AUD/USD

fx_assumption.note: Flat across every year (full p88). DFS used 0.67 (full p5). Sits at the 18th percentile of a 35-analyst panel (full p89).

real_or_nominal: Real 2026 A$; pre- and post-tax; ungeared, no financing (full p17, p88)
what_the_integration_is: GL1 has signed a binding Share Purchase Agreement (announced 15 July 2026) with IGO Limited to buy 100% of IGO Nova Pty Ltd, owner of the Nova Operation. This is an outright acquisition, not toll treatment or a joint venture, and the purchase price is not disclosed in these documents (full p2, p49, p51-52). Manna ore is trucked 135 km south to Nova, where IGO's 1.8 Mtpa nickel-copper concentrator is converted to spodumene: the C120 jaw, SAG/ball mills and flotation cells are retained, and two HP300 secondary crushers, two-size TOMRA ore sorting, an HP200 pebble crusher, magnetic separation, desliming and a lined brine pond are added (full p2, p50, p75). GL1 also inherits Nova's tailings cell, power station, bore-field, water treatment, laboratory, 500-bed camp, aerodrome and haul-road/corridor licences, which replaces the DFS greenfield concentrator at Manna (full p6, p47, p52, p81). Manna still needs its own mine services area, a 203-room camp, Zenith-supplied power and the haul corridor, and export runs through the third-party Port of Esperance (Southern Ports) with no new port infrastructure (full p14, p80-83).

ore_haulage.from: Manna ROM pad (M28/414); ROM load-out with no rehandle (Figure 21, full p83)
ore_haulage.to: Nova plant ROM/crusher (M28/376); crushing and ore sorting happen at Nova, after the haul

distance_km.note: 135 km after upgrade on the dedicated private haul corridor 'for the life of mine'. The model applies 135 km to all 23.67 Mt (Table 20, full p83). During build-up the haul uses a 190 km interim public route (summary p3). The map label is ~135 km (full p3).

ore_haulage.mode: Road haulage on a dedicated private corridor by 140 t PBS quad road trains (Figure 21, full p83; JORC calls them 'road train', full p39). The haul is charged on delivered ROM tonnes under a single logistics-consortium contract still in negotiation: indication issued 6 Sep 2026, 45-day exclusivity, then LOI and contract (full p97).

haul_cost.note: Real 2026 A$. Composite of haul 15.2 + road maintenance 1.2 + owner fuel 1.4, less an unquantified 'integration discount' (Figure 21 graphic, full p83). Table 1 rounds it to A$17.0/t (full p4). LOM cost A$402.6M over 23.67 Mt. My arithmetic: ~A$0.126/t-km and ~A$150/t SC5.5 (8.8 t ore per t concentrate). Rate card is an Australis benchmark net of an integrated supply-chain discount and is not yet contracted (summary p4).

tonnes_hauled_Mtpa.note: Steady-state crusher feed at Nova of 175,000 t/month (2.10 Mtpa); 23.67 Mt hauled over LOM (full p83). All ROM is hauled before sorting, so ~30% of it (7.1 Mt LOM) is hauled 135 km and then rejected to waste by the Nova sorters (full p11, p77). DFS crusher feed was 1.8 Mtpa with no haul.

road_upgrades_or_capex.note: Stage 1 'make-safe' of 162 km is in pre-production capital at A$9.45M; Table 8 (full p16) labels the same A$9.45M as 'corridor, haul road, rail crossing, communications'. Stage 2 (50 km) and the final 160 km RAV7 upgrade are in deferred capital funded from cash flow, with no separate amount given; they sit inside ~A$59.8M of deferred scope that also covers power conversion, tailings lift and the mica pre-float (full p6). The eastern haul road and ARTC rail crossing complete the corridor. Road maintenance (A$1.2/t) is inside the haul rate.

processing.where: Nova (IGO's former nickel-copper concentrator, converted to spodumene duty), 135 km south of Manna

throughput_Mtpa.note: 2.10 Mtpa crushed (342.5 t/h at 70% utilisation; crushing design 2.20 Mtpa). After 30% sorter mass rejection, 1.47 Mtpa goes to the mill (mill design 184 t/h, 1.50 Mtpa). Nova's design basis is 1.8 Mtpa, but the retained circuit alone handles only 1.51 Mtpa (full p77-78). DFS: 1.8 Mtpa (full p4).

head_grade_Li2O_pct.note: LOM ROM/crusher feed: 23.67 Mt mining inventory (OP 0.91%, UG 0.83%). Mill head grade after sorting is not stated. Ore Reserve grade is 0.89%.

recovery_pct.note: Overall and fixed, same as the DFS. Includes sorter losses (94.4% lithia retained at sorting, full p79). Wet plant recovery is 78.0% (full p15) or 77.36% (full p91); spodumene flotation 78.4% (full p91). No new testwork since the DFS (full p3).

concentrate_grade_Li2O_pct.note: Also a DSO product at 1.5% Li2O (336.9 kt, March 2027 to early 2028)

concentrate_output_ktpa.unit: ktpa SC5.5, average of first 7 years
concentrate_output_ktpa.note: LOM 2,684.3 kt SC5.5 (2,684,259 t, full p17) plus 336.9 kt DSO. DFS: 236 ktpa over the first 7 years and 2,763.5 kt LOM.

processing_cost.note: 'Processing and Infrastructure' line: A$671M LOM, A$250/t SC5.5. Power is charged as energy x tariff on its own line and is in neither the mining nor the processing rate (full p82). Which opex line carries power is not stated. Nova power runs on a Zenith pass-through to Year 3, then self-operated at 14.66 c/kWh.

toll_or_access_fee.note: Not applicable. GL1 is buying 100% of IGO Nova Pty Ltd and will own and operate the plant, so there is no toll, access fee or JV. The acquisition consideration is not disclosed in either document, and no acquisition line appears in the capex tables or the NPV waterfall.

plant_modification_capex.note: 'Nova, the plant' (Table 8; A$31.2M in Table 21, full p84). Excludes deferred Nova power capital (A$20.334M, full p82) and the deferred mica pre-float circuit. Process plant and infrastructure directs total A$62.9M vs A$142.9M in the DFS (full p84).

concentrate_logistics.route: Nova, then road ~370 km to Esperance (via Norseman per the map, full p3), then a storage hub ~20 km from the berth (60 kt covered facility: igloo cell for concentrate, open yard for DSO; 'Campbell's yard' per the Figure 19 label). Shuttle trucks back-tip into the ship-loader hopper at 1,500 t/h at the Port of Esperance, and 25 kt parcels ship to China (full p82-83).
concentrate_logistics.mode: Road: 140 t PBS quads for concentrate and 90 t road trains for DSO; then bulk ocean freight in 25 kt parcels (full p83)

distance_km.note: Nova to Esperance by road. The map shows Manna–Esperance ~500 km for comparison (full p3).

cost.note: Road haul Nova to Esperance, LOM A$100.9M. DSO costs A$46.8/t (A$15.8M). Road + port is A$57.8/t vs A$78.0/t in the DFS (Table 1, full p4).

concentrate_logistics.port: Port of Esperance (Southern Ports); no new port infrastructure. Berth allocation, ship-loader method and any Southern Ports capital are conditions precedent still to be confirmed (full p83, p97).

port_cost.note: Dome storage, shiploader and wharfage; wharfage alone is A$4.16/t (Figure 21). DSO A$11.7/t open pad. LOM A$58.1M.

ocean_freight.note: CIF China in 25 kt parcels; DSO A$27.7/t; LOM A$110.2M. Coordination, forwarding and survey add A$29.6M (A$3.0M/yr). Shipping and port total A$198.0M = A$73.8/t SC5.5. Total logistics including the ROM haul is A$724.2M = A$269.8/t SC5.5 = A$30.6/t ore.

concentrate_logistics.sale_basis: CIF China, SC5.5, priced at 5.5/6 (0.9167) x the SC6 CIF deck. DSO sold at A$506/t for 1.5% Li2O.

mining.method: Conventional open pit: Manna Main in 3 stages plus Manna North and South satellites; 100 t excavators and trucks on ore, 400 t excavators and 240 t trucks on waste; 5 m ore benches, 10 m waste benches. Followed by underground top-down long-hole open stoping beneath the pits with no backfill (PFS-level design). Contractor schedule of rates, described elsewhere as an owner fleet with an operator (full p7, p84, p94).

strip_ratio.note: 236.2 Mt waste (including 12.23 Mt subgrade at 0.33% Li2O) over 15.48 Mt OP inventory. Shown as 15.3 in Table 9 (full p66). Total OP movement 251.7 Mt.

ore_mined_Mtpa.note: Schedule based on 2.1 Mtpa (dry) ROM feed. Peak total material movement ~48 Mtpa (full p7); fleet averages 50 Mtpa (full p36). LOM 23.67 Mt at 0.88% Li2O, of which 88-89% is Probable Reserve and 11-12% Inferred.

life_of_mine_years.note: Combined mine and processing life. ES Table 1 gives producing life 12.5 yrs (full p48); section 1.8 gives a 12.8-year mine life (full p61). OP 85 months (7.1 yrs); UG ore 103 months, starting 51 months after the OP. DFS: 14.33 yrs.

mining_cost.note: OP is A$4.74/t total material moved (LOM A$1,194M including A$39.8M capitalised; A$1,155M cash). UG is A$77.5/t ore and A$55.0/t total moved (A$635.8M; A$596.0M in the opex table). Per tonne crushed: OP 48.8 + UG 25.2 (full p16). Mining is 62.6% of opex.

risks_noted: Haul route: build-up uses a 190 km interim public route with multi-contractor and haul-road traffic risk, but the model costs all 23.67 Mt at 135 km on the upgraded corridor (summary p3; full p80, p83).
Logistics rates not contracted: product logistics (A$724.2M LOM, A$269.8/t) is the largest operating cost outside mining; haulage LOI due December 2026 (summary p4; full p97).
Port: berth allocation, ship-loader method and any Southern Ports capital are unconfirmed conditions precedent (full p83).
Schedule: ore sorters must be operational by March 2027 with zero float; a late start at Manna or Nova delays first DSO revenue (summary p4; full p15).
Capacity relies on the new front end: the retained Nova crush/SAG/ball circuit handles only 1.51 Mtpa vs the 2.10 Mtpa schedule (full p77-78).

Metallurgy: no new testwork since the DFS. WHIMS is the largest single loss (12.1%), HIC feed density is unverified, and sorter performance still needs TOMRA tests on Manna ore (full p3, p79; summary p4).
Tailings: ~12 months of storage at handover, first raise needed ~mid-2028; underground tailings placement is not approved and not in the model (full p82).
Approvals: the Works Approval, NVCP Stage 2 and the L28/96 southern corridor survey gap gate Manna early works; 13 Nova approvals are still in programme (summary p4; full p97-98).

Acquisition and transition: depends on Nova SPA completion and handover (Nov 2026) and transfer of 18 licence groups and 15 mining proposals. The DSO fallback of processing at Nova also needs completion (full p97; summary p1).
Native title and land access: the Ngadju NTMA at Nova may need amending because Nova mining ceases in Dec Q 2026; no Pastoral Access Agreement has been negotiated (full p41-42).
Price and FX: NPV is most sensitive to these, with break-even at a 32.6% price fall. Part of the uplift over the DFS comes from the higher price deck, not the integration (full p5; summary p3).
Geological confidence: 11-12% of the production target is Inferred (74% of it underground); underground design is PFS-level only (full p4, p9, p22).

Funding not secured: the Lopal US$75M prepayment is conditional on FID and documentation; Canmax and DSO prepayments are unagreed; DSO offtake is non-binding; equity dilution is possible (summary p1-2; full p17-18).
Estimate basis: no class-of-estimate contingency, a 10% owner's contingency not drawn in the cash flow, and working capital excluded from capex (full p84).
Power: Nova runs on a Zenith pass-through only to Year 3, then self-operates; A$20.334M of Nova power capital is deferred (full p82; summary p3).
data_quality_notes: The file labelled 'summary' is not the announcement. It is Executive Summary printed pp. 58-63 (funding, risks, opportunities, price-deck appendix). The ASX announcement is full pp. 1-43, and ES printed p. 57 is in neither file.
Nova acquisition price is not disclosed and does not appear in capex, the NPV waterfall or funding.
Producing life: 13 yrs (full p4, p15, p17, p88) vs 12.5 (full p48); mine life 12.8 yrs (full p61).
Post-tax IRR 119.6% (full p4) vs 120% (full p1, p48, p86). DFS C1 965.0 vs 964.6 and DFS AISC 1,101 vs 1,104.5 (full p4 vs p48/p86).
DSO credit (0.81) A$/t crushed in Table 3 (full p7) vs (7.2) in Table 9 (full p16).

Capex 'Other' A$59.769M (full p16) is unexplained and equals the ~A$59.8M deferred-capex figure (full p6). Pre-production build is written A$163.076M (full p85) vs A$163.7M. 'A$9.9M under the A$188M target' does not compute (full p84).
Estimate accuracy: Class 3 ±20% (full p3) vs ±15% (JORC, full p40, p43).
Wet plant recovery 78.0% (full p15) vs 77.36% (full p91). Mill feed 16.1 Mt (full p15) vs 16.6 Mt (full p11, p75). Inferred share 11% (full p9) vs 12% (full p22, p61).
LOM price US$1,510 SC5.5 / US$1,647 SC6 (tables) vs US$1,502 / US$1,638 (Figure 21, full p83). Transport A$526.2M (Table 20) vs 'transport and other opex' A$545.4M (Figure 21).
Road works: Stage 1 162 km make-safe, Stage 2 50 km and a final 160 km RAV7 upgrade do not reconcile with the 135 km haul, and the deferred road capex amount is not given (full p80).

The tenure table lists M28/414 (Manna) as 'mine and sorting circuit' (full p52), but the process sections and figures put crushing and sorting at Nova (full p75, p77, p81, p83). The haul tonnage (23.67 Mt = all ROM) is consistent with sorting at Nova.
Mining basis is described as contractor schedule of rates (full p7, p40), 'owner fleet basis' (full p84) and 'GLR owner fleet with an operator' (full p94).
JORC Table 1 Infrastructure (full p39) still carries DFS wording: an owner-operated gas-fired power station and a process plant on M28/414.
Strip-ratio inputs: waste is 211.8 Mt (full p10, p63) vs 236.2 Mt (full p66, p72); 15.28 uses 236.2 including subgrade.
DSO start: March 2027 (full p14, p91) vs crushing and sorting starting April 2027 on DSO (full p78).
